name: Social Security Fund (กองทุนประกันสังคม)
authority: Social Security Act B.E. 2533 (1990) s.33 (an employee aged 15 to 60 at entry is insured and stays insured past 60), s.46 (employee and employer contribute at equal rates), s.47 (the employer deducts the employee contribution from wages); the 5% rate of the Ministerial Regulation on contribution rates; Ministerial Regulation Prescribing the Minimum and Maximum Wage for Calculating the Contributions of an Insured Person under Section 33 B.E. 2568 (Royal Gazette 12 December 2025): from 1 January 2026 to 31 December 2028 the wage base is not less than 1,650 and not more than 17,500 baht a month (20,000 from 2029, 23,000 from 2032). https://www.sso.go.th/

rules.when: !has(employee.facts.sso_excluded_category) && (employee.date_of_birth == "" || employment.start_date == "" || ((age_on(employee.date_of_birth, employment.start_date) >= 15 && age_on(employee.date_of_birth, employment.start_date) <= 60) || (has(employee.facts.sso_continuing_insured) && employee.facts.sso_continuing_insured == true)))

configuration.limitation: Engine: the month's SSO wage (base salary and fixed allowances paid for normal working time; overtime, holiday-work pay and leave cash-out are outside s.5 "wage") is floored at 1,650 and capped at 17,500; each side pays 5% rounded to the baht. SSA s.33: an employee "not below fifteen years and not over sixty years" is insured — read on the age at the contract's start (`employment.start_date`), so an insured person who reaches 60 in the same employment stays insured and one hired at 61 or over is not; an unrecorded date of birth is charged. https://www.sso.go.th/wpr/download/download_by_pool_file/47435 SSA s.4 and the Royal Decree issued under it exclude certain employment (a foreign government or international organisation, an employer posted temporarily from abroad, a private-school teacher, a household employee where no business is carried on, seasonal agricultural work): employee fact sso_excluded_category (customer input) takes the employee outside the scheme. A month with no wage paid charges nothing: the engine assesses a scheme only on wages paid (SSA s.47: deducted "for each time wages are paid"). https://www.sso.go.th/wpr/download/download_by_pool_file/47435 Ministerial Regulation prescribing the minimum and maximum wages used as the base for contributions of insured persons under s.33 B.E. 2568 (signed 11 December 2025, Royal Gazette 12 December 2025): 1,650-17,500 from 1 January 2026 to 31 December 2028, 1,650-20,000 from 1 January 2029 to 31 December 2031, 1,650-23,000 from 1 January 2032 (as reported from the gazette by Thairath, https://www.thairath.co.th/news/politic/2899402; the gazette PDF itself was not read). SSA s.33 para 2: an employee already insured who reaches 60 and is still an employee of an employer subject to the Act stays insured — read for a person who moves to this employer without a break while insured (employee fact sso_continuing_insured), so the age test at entry does not exclude them.

name: Workmen's Compensation Fund (กองทุนเงินทดแทน)
authority: Workmen's Compensation Act B.E. 2537 as amended B.E. 2561 ss.5, 44-45 https://www.sso.go.th/wpr/download/download_by_pool_file/47436; the Ministry of Labour notification on business types, sizes and areas liable to contribute, contribution rates, deposits and the assessment and collection of contributions (21 February 2019, under WCA ss.44 para 1 and 45) cl.5 (an employer of one or more employees), cl.6 and Table 1 (1,091 business codes, 0.20%-1.00% of wages), cl.11 (annual wages capped at "สองแสนสี่หมื่นบาทต่อปี" a person; whole-baht rounding), cl.19 (experience rating from the fifth year) https://www.sso.go.th/wpr/download/download_by_pool_file/14479

refuse_when.message: Thailand WCF needs the employer's business code (entity risk_class, a code of the Ministry of Labour Table 1) or the rate the Social Security Office notified (entity fact wcf_rate_percent).

configuration.limitation: Engine: the employer's annual WCF liability accrued month by month on the wages for normal working hours and days (WCA s.5 "wages" — overtime, holiday work and holiday overtime are outside), the year's assessable wages capped at 240,000 baht a person (cl.11), at the rate of the employer's business code in Table 1 (entity risk_class) or, from the fifth year, the experience-rated rate the SSO notified (entity fact wcf_rate_percent, cl.19), rounded to the baht (cl.11: fifty satang or more counts as one baht). The law collects it in advance each January on estimated wages (cl.13) and settles it on the Kor Tor 20 Kor statement (cl.14-15); both are TASKS rows.

name: Provident fund (กองทุนสำรองเลี้ยงชีพ)
authority: Provident Fund Act B.E. 2530 (1987) s.10: member contributions of 2%-15% of wages; the employer contributes not less than the member and not more than 15%.

configuration.limitation: Voluntary: charged only for a member — a PVD standing of kind MEMBER whose election `employee_percent` is the rate the member chose. Engine: the member contributes that rate of the PVD wage; the employer the higher of the fund-rule rate (entity fact pvd_employer_percent) and the member rate, at most 15%. Fund rules that scale the employer rate with service are not modelled.

name: Personal income tax withholding (ภ.ง.ด.1)
authority: Revenue Code s.40(1), s.42 bis, s.47, s.48(1), s.50(1) and Departmental Instruction Tor Por 4/2528 (withholding by annualising the income); Revenue Code Amendment Act (No. 44) B.E. 2560 (personal allowance 60,000; expense 50% up to 100,000; brackets to 5,000,000) and Royal Decree No. 470 (first 150,000 of net income exempt). https://www.rd.go.th/english/6045.html

configuration.limitation: Engine (Departmental Instruction Tor Por 4/2528): the year's regular income is estimated as the PND1 wage already paid this year (`year.ordinary` + `year.severance`) plus the contract's monthly taxable pay (the monthly wage plus every non-wage contract allowance line, benefits in kind included) for this and every remaining month; the annual tax on it (less the expense deduction of 50% up to 100,000, s.42 bis; the personal allowance 60,000, s.47(1)(a); 60,000 for a spouse without income, s.47(1)(b), from the profile columns; the PND1 elections declared on Lor Yor 01 — 30,000 a child and 30,000 more for a second or later child born from 2018, s.47(1)(c), and other annual deductions; the employee SSO contribution (s.47(1)(ฌ), as paid) and the provident fund member contribution up to 500,000, each as charged this year plus this month's charge for the remaining months) less the tax already withheld this year (`charged.year.PND1.employee`) is spread over the remaining months, so December trues the year up; income above the regular wage this month (a bonus, back pay) is withheld in full this month as the difference between the annual tax with and without it. Progressive scale: 0% to 150,000, 5% to 300,000, 10% to 500,000, 15% to 750,000, 20% to 1,000,000, 25% to 2,000,000, 30% to 5,000,000, 35% above. An over-withholding is not refunded through payroll (the employee claims it on PND91). Income from a previous employer in the same year is not on the context; Severance pay (part `severance`) is exempt up to the last 300 days' wages (ten monthly wages with fixed allowances; 300 day-rates for a daily-paid employee) and at most 300,000, except on retirement or the end of a fixed term (Ministerial Regulation No. 126 (B.E. 2509) item 2(51) as amended by No. 217 (B.E. 2542), https://www.rd.go.th/2455.html); the excess is withheld in its month. The separate-taxation election of s.48(5) is not modelled. Lor Yor 01 items (Revenue Department deduction table, https://www.rd.go.th/59674.html; Revenue Code s.47 and Ministerial Regulation No. 126): parents aged 60+ with income of at most 30,000, 30,000 each (at most four: own and spouse's); a disabled or incapacitated dependant 60,000 each; parents' health insurance up to 15,000; life insurance up to 100,000; home-loan interest up to 100,000; pension life insurance up to 15% of income and 200,000, together with the provident fund member contribution at most 500,000; other declared deductions (RMF, ThaiESG, donations, …) in other_annual_deductions. A taxpayer aged 65 or over in the tax year, or a disabled person, is exempt on up to 190,000 of income (RD form for the 190,000 exemption, https://www.rd.go.th/fileadmin/tax_pdf/pit/2569/300669_65year_94.pdf), less any part used elsewhere (election exempt_190k_used_elsewhere). Income and tax from an earlier employer in the same year (Lor Yor 01 / 50 Tawi: elections previous_employer_income, previous_employer_tax) join the annual estimate (Departmental Instruction Tor Por 4/2528). Separate taxation of severance (Revenue Code s.48(5); Director-General Notification on income tax No. 45 cl.3(2), 5 as applied in RD ruling 0702/6442, https://www.rd.go.th/65818.html): on the election severance_separate with five years' service, the taxable severance up to the last monthly wage × years of service (a part year over 183 days counts) is taxed apart: less 7,000 × years, less 50% of the rest, on the progressive scale; the excess joins the year's income. A piece worker's regular monthly income for the annual estimate is the month's assessed ordinary wage.

name: Employee Welfare Fund (กองทุนสงเคราะห์ลูกจ้าง)
authority: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 (1998) ss.126-131 with the Ministerial Regulation prescribing the contribution rates of the Employee Welfare Fund B.E. 2568 cl.1, 3(1): from 1 October 2026 to 30 September 2031 "เงินสะสมของลูกจ้าง ๐.๒๕" and "เงินสมทบของนายจ้าง ๐.๒๕" per cent of the member's wages (0.5% each from 1 October 2031). https://ratchakitcha.soc.go.th/documents/86102.pdf

configuration.limitation: Members are the employees of an undertaking of ten or more (s.130 para 1: `headcount`). s.130 para 2: the Act does not apply to an undertaking whose employer provides a provident fund, or welfare on termination or death, meeting the Ministerial Regulation — entity fact ewf_exempt (customer input, per owner ruling: the exemption is per business). Contributions are due "at each payment" even when the wage is paid late (s.131 paras 1-2); a 5% a month surcharge applies to late or short remittance (s.131 para 3). The base is the member's wages for normal working time, no ceiling stated; rounded to the satang. Office of the Council of State English translation (https://www.vertic.org/media/National%20Legislation/Thailand/TH_Labor_Protection_Act.pdf).
